simple: A cloud service that protects websites and APIs: nothing to install, a site is onboarded in three steps with ready-made policies. Blocks OWASP Top 10 attacks (SQL injection, XSS, request forgery) and zero-day attacks, filters traffic by country and IP reputation (Tor, anonymous proxies, VPNs, whole networks by ASN); every request gets a risk score, and cloud machine learning on data from a worldwide sensor network quickly recognizes new threats. Protects JSON and GraphQL APIs, builds rules from an OpenAPI schema, and also finds forgotten and unknown (“shadow”) APIs in the traffic on its own and protects them right away. Filters DDoS with no volume limits — both volumetric and application-layer — limits request rates and protects the site’s DNS records. Tells humans from bots with machine learning and recognizes individual devices behind a single IP address; stops password guessing, scraping and sign-ins with stolen passwords, and for privileged accounts learns the usual sign-in behavior and warns of account takeover. Scans uploaded files with antivirus, masks card numbers and other sensitive data in responses, and controls third-party scripts on pages (CSP/SRI) against Magecart. A built-in vulnerability scanner safely tests your sites and closes the findings with WAF rules in one click (a “virtual patch”). Includes Barracuda CloudGen Access (ZTNA) licenses — employee access to internal applications without a VPN; there is also a containerized WAF to protect traffic between microservices, load balancing, a CDN, a dedicated IP address per application, sign-in via SAML, OpenID Connect, JWT or certificates, and 60 days of logs with export to multiple SIEMs.
